prompt:
超写实日系地铁街拍摄影，竖版约 3:4。一名明确成年的东亚女性，20+，成年学院风 Cosplay 模特，站在日本通勤电车车厢中央过道里，身体以三分之二背身朝向镜头，腰胯略微侧转，头部回头看向摄影者。摄影者坐在车厢座位附近，以 50–85mm 等效镜头从人物后侧偏低位置抓拍，完整拍到头部、腰胯、双腿和部分手提包，周围保留大量真实乘客与车厢细节。

人物为中小骨架，肩膀偏窄，腰部纤细，髋部自然圆润，大腿匀称修长，比例真实，不要健美或夸张身材。双腿自然并拢站立，重心落在一条腿上，另一条腿轻微放松；右手垂在身体侧后方，提着一只黑色小型皮革手提包 / shoulder bag。

人物留乌黑色下巴长度直 Bob，发尾整齐内扣，额前为厚碎齐刘海，脸侧发丝自然贴住下颌。回头时只看到偏侧脸，眼神安静直接看镜头，表情冷淡、不笑。

服装为纯黑色长袖学院风水手领上衣＋黑色短百褶裙，上衣修身，肩颈处有深色海军领结构和少量白色领结 / 领巾细节；裙摆非常短但保持正常完整覆盖，百褶自然向外展开。下身穿烟黑色超薄半透明连裤丝袜，约 10–20D，能明显透出自然肤色，腿部在车厢冷白灯下带柔和灰黑光泽。脚部可被画面裁掉，不强行出现鞋子。

场景是真实日本城市通勤电车车厢：两侧坐着大量乘客，多数低头看手机或休息；银色金属扶杆、顶部行李架、白色三角吊环、浅灰车顶和车门、彩色广告牌密集分布。人物站在过道中央，前后乘客形成自然夹景，车厢狭窄、生活化，不要空车厢。

光线为地铁车厢顶部冷白荧光灯＋少量窗外自然光，整体偏青灰、低饱和，人物黑发与黑色服装较深，肤色自然偏白。使用浅到中等景深：人物清晰，前景乘客和远处广告轻微虚化，但车厢结构仍可辨认。

整体呈 2000s–2010s 日本街拍 / 通勤抓拍质感：轻微颗粒、自然锐度、有限动态范围、少量镜头压缩感，不要棚拍、HDR 或电影级调色。

重点锁定：成年东亚女性＋日本地铁车厢＋三分之二背身站姿＋回头看镜头＋短黑 Bob 齐刘海＋黑色学院风水手服＋黑色短百褶裙＋烟黑超薄连裤丝袜＋黑色手提包＋两侧真实乘客＋吊环扶杆＋冷白车厢灯＋日系长焦抓拍。

避免：未成年人、真实学生身份、长发、高马尾、正面站姿、白袜、网袜、裸腿、彩色裙、空车厢、强背景虚化、动漫脸、CG 感、塑料皮肤、多余肢体、水印和乱码文字。

promptTranslations.en:
Hyper-realistic Japanese subway street photography, vertical format approx 3:4. An unambiguously adult East Asian woman, 20+, adult academy-style cosplay model, standing in the central aisle of a Japanese commuter train carriage, body in a two-thirds back view facing the camera, waist and hips slightly turned to the side, head turned back looking at the photographer. The photographer is seated near the carriage seats, capturing with a 50–85mm equivalent lens from a low angle behind the subject, fully framing the head, waist, hips, legs, and part of the handbag, with abundant real passengers and carriage details retained around.

The subject has a small-to-medium frame, narrower shoulders, slim waist, naturally rounded hips, well-proportioned and slender thighs, realistic proportions, no athletic or exaggerated physique. Legs standing naturally close together, weight resting on one leg with the other slightly relaxed; right hand hanging at the side-rear, holding a small black leather handbag / shoulder bag.

The subject has jet-black chin-length straight bob hair, ends neatly curled inward, thick textured straight-across blunt bangs on the forehead, side strands naturally framing the jawline. Looking back reveals mostly a three-quarter profile, eyes calmly looking directly into the camera, cold and unsmiling expression.

Outfit is a solid black long-sleeved academy-style sailor-collar top + black short pleated skirt, slim-fit top, dark navy sailor collar structure at the neck and shoulders with minimal white neckerchief / tie details; skirt is very short but maintains proper complete coverage, pleats naturally flaring outward. Lower body wears sheer smoky black ultra-thin pantyhose, approx 10–20D, clearly revealing natural skin tone beneath, legs displaying a soft grey-black sheen under the cool white carriage lights. Feet can be cropped out, no forced appearance of shoes.

The setting is an authentic Japanese urban commuter train carriage: numerous passengers seated on both sides, mostly looking down at their phones or resting; silver metal grab poles, overhead luggage racks, white triangular hanging straps, light grey ceiling and train doors, densely distributed colorful advertisement posters. The subject stands in the center of the aisle, passengers in front and behind forming a natural framing, carriage feels cramped and everyday-lived-in, no empty train.

Lighting is cool white fluorescent lights from the subway ceiling + a hint of natural light from windows, overall leaning cyan-grey, low saturation, subject's black hair and black clothing are deep, skin tone is naturally fair. Using shallow to medium depth of field: subject is sharp, foreground passengers and distant ads slightly blurred, but train structure remains identifiable.

Overall 2000s–2010s Japanese street photography / commuter snapshot aesthetic: subtle grain, natural sharpness, limited dynamic range, slight lens compression, no studio lighting, no HDR, no cinematic color grading.

Key focuses: adult East Asian woman + Japanese subway carriage + two-thirds back standing pose + looking back at camera + short black bob with blunt bangs + black academy-style sailor suit + black short pleated skirt + sheer smoky black pantyhose + black handbag + real passengers on both sides + hanging straps and grab poles + cool white carriage lights + Japanese telephoto candid snapshot.

Avoid: minors, actual student identity, long hair, high ponytail, frontal standing pose, white socks, fishnets, bare legs, colored skirts, empty carriage, heavy bokeh, anime face, CG look, plastic skin, extra limbs, watermarks, and garbled text.

summaryTranslations.en: Realistic Japanese train portrait: a black-haired woman in a black sailor suit and black sheer pantyhose looking back over her shoulder, set in an authentic carriage environment.
